name: TEST 2 — Toggles (checkboxes)
description: Proves toggle mapping works. Send 1.0 to turn ON, 0.0 to turn OFF. The checkbox in huff should visually check/uncheck and the effect should appear or disappear immediately.

mappings._section: Send 1.0 to turn ON, 0.0 to turn OFF. Watch the checkbox in the huff panel.

mappings.note: EXPECTED: Glitch On checkbox ticks. All glitch tiles appear or vanish.
EXPECTED: Flow On checkbox ticks. Warp effect toggles on/off.
EXPECTED: Symmetry On checkbox ticks. Image mirrors on/off.
EXPECTED: Solarize On checkbox ticks. Colour inversion effect toggles.
EXPECTED: Base Video checkbox ticks. Source video layer on/off.
